caption: crash and cortex, chained - the comedy platformer where the villain is the second player character.
about: Crash twinsanity (2004) is the series' cult comedy chapter: cortex as unwilling partner, the two rolled into a human snowball, humiliskate down the mountain and a musical score that has been beloved ever since. The platforming bends the series' corridor law into open-island exploration, and the joke density holds up better than almost any licensed platformer of the era.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
